title: Classification of minimizing solutions to a two-dimensional Allen-Cahn system
summary: We study bounded entire solutions $u:\mathbb{R}^2\to \mathbb{R}^2$ that minimize the Allen-Cahn functional \begin{equation*} J(u,Ω)=\int_Ω\left(\frac12 |\nabla u|^2+W(u)\right)\,d\mathbf{x}, \end{equation*} with the $D_3$-invariant triple-well potential \begin{equation*} W(u_1,u_2)=|u|^4+2u_1u_2^2-\frac23 u_1^3-|u|^2+\frac23. \end{equation*} We obtain a complete classification of entire minimizing solutions.
